thread:
maya: kicked off canary for rwd-v6p1-int4 at 4% traffic. initial perf wins are there (p50 -24%, cost -33%) but two signals popped: code-complete MRR down ~1.9% abs and a small KL drift on logits for longdoc slices. thinking about a multilayer gate (zscore + KL + truncation) before we enable auto-rollback. thoughts? :satellite:
felix: paste the slices please — want to see volumes and whether this is concentrated. :mag:
zoe: quick CSV extract from the run:
```
slice,queries,mrr,baseline_mrr,delta_abs,kl_drift,trunc_err_rate
chat-short,11200,0.795,0.792,+0.3,0.002,0.01
code-complete,2100,0.621,0.640,-1.9,0.018,0.03
longdoc-retrieval,980,0.487,0.506,-1.9,0.022,0.07
faq,3400,0.738,0.742,-0.4,0.004,0.02
```
maya: two immediate notes — longdoc volume is lowish (980) but truncation err is high (7%). code-complete has decent volume and elevated KL (0.018).
jia: proposal: safety-lattice gate composed of three signals: 1) zscore of delta_mrr over baseline, 2) KL divergence on output logits normalized to 30d baseline, 3) token-truncation percent. Each slice gets a priority multiplier. If any two signals exceed slice-specific thresholds simultaneously we trigger a "safety leash" (soft action).
felix: define actions and numeric thresholds?
jia: draft numeric plan:
- per-slice priority weights: code-complete=2.5, longdoc-retrieval=1.8
- signals & thresholds (slice-weighted):
  * zscore_delta_mrr_soft: > 1.6 (soft), hard > 2.8
  * kl_norm_soft: > 0.012, hard > 0.025
  * trunc_err_soft: > 0.04 (4pp), hard > 0.08
- safety leash (soft): if any pair of soft thresholds exceeded over a 30m window -> throttle to 15% traffic to new variant + spawn stealth-shadow (no routing) for 4h and increase sampling x4 on affected slice
- hard rollback: if either a) any single hard threshold sustained 45m OR b) paired hard thresholds sustained 20m -> immediate rollback to prior pinned variant and page SRE.
zoe: +1 on pairwise logic. also add a min-query filter (min 800 queries per 30m) to avoid noisy small slices. longdoc is borderline; perhaps lower min for longdoc but increase the sampling multiplier so we get better stats before auto-action.
maya: operational detail: Dedicated customers should have a per-customer "safety leash level" which controls whether soft actions are steering-only or require operator approval. Hosted customers default to auto-steer on soft. We'll document the mapping.
felix: what about coldstart bias? quant int4 models often show warming artifacts — we should ignore first 12% of traffic per slice for 8m for gating to avoid spurious triggers.
jia: agreed. also add an "escalation braid": when soft action triggers, send a compact incident summary to #oncall-eng-ml and create a short-lived rollback runbook with links to snapshot diffs (top 20 example prompts where outputs deviated).
zoe: one more metric: increase hallucation spot-checks for code-complete (we saw token-level halluc +0.6pp). Add halluc_delta_pp soft 0.4pp, hard 1.0pp as separate immediate triggers — halluc is a primary safety signal and can shortcut to a hard rollback if above hard threshold for 15m.
ci-bot: smoke results for rwd-v6p1-int4: unit-tests \u2705, basic-load \u2705, safety-lattice WARN (signals: code-complete, longdoc-retrieval)

signals:

  - name: kl_norm
    soft: 0.012
    hard: 0.025
  - name: trunc_err

    hard: 0.08

  hard: rollback ; page SRE
min_query_filter: 800 (30m) ; coldstart_ignore: first_12pct_8m
per_customer_leash: Hosted=auto_steer ; Dedicated=ops_approval_by_default

felix: next steps: 1) zoe increase sampling and rerun targeted shadow for both slices overnight (x6) 2) jia encode safety-lattice into gate engine with pairwise logic + min_query filter 3) maya update rollout playbook and per-customer leash mapping 4) felix to ratify numeric thresholds after shadow results. tag @jia for implementation signoff. :white_check_mark:
jia: got it, will start implementing pairwise check and stealth-shadow plumbing tomorrow.
maya: I'll hold auto-rollback off until we have shadow run results. thanks all :thumbsup:
